title: OpenAI ships autonomy a day after canceling a model for being too autonomous
description:
OpenAI began rolling out Dots, always-on agents that run in the background, a week after it pulled a model for acting on its own.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-september-30-2026/

In the headlines (TCR #237):
- OpenAI launched Dots, always-on agents with 4,000+ app connections, and an app-store rival
- Six frontier labs signed a "morally binding" AI self-policing pact at the White House
- Nvidia announced an agent-safety platform with more than 100 organizations working with it; a nonprofit sued OpenAI over rogue agents
- McKinsey estimated 11 million US workers may need to change occupations within a decade
- Two teams got gene editors past the liver into mouse brain (48%) and lung (27%)
- The NRC proposed a 339-page rewrite to speed reactors as the data-center buildout hit limits
